expectations.text: The reply reports the uncaught JSON parse error (SyntaxError) captured from the page console or page errors after the click
expectations.evidence: The reply says "The page threw one uncaught error on the click: `Expected ',' or '}' after property value in JSON at position 12 (line 1 column 13)`" and adds that "`JSON.parse` throws a `SyntaxError`."

expectations.text: The reply names the malformed JSON literal (missing closing brace) as the cause
expectations.evidence: The reply quotes "const data = JSON.parse('{"total": 12');   // missing closing }" and says "The JSON is missing its closing `}`."
